notes.title: Tumble Egg 1.1 - Achievements Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Tumble Egg now features Steam achievements -[/b][/p][list][*][p]Six brand-new achievements have been added to the game to indicate player progress and reward completed challenges! [/p][/*][*][p]The achievements will require players to complete qualifying tasks, even if they have already been completed in previous builds of the game. [/p][/*][*][p]Season/level completion achievements will be unlocked when the player reaches the last nest of each season.
